title: 第19章 你没救了孩子回家吧第20章 谁敢欺负我天衍宗弟子
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: 不顾魏明微白的脸色，殷裴讥讽的说道：“我也是佩服你们天衍宗，挑了一个金丹一重的人做大师姐，我玄天剑宗首席大弟子修为都快突破元婴圆满了。”
“你们宗门要是实在没好的弟子，要不干脆让我来当你们的首席弟子吧，哈哈哈。”
殷裴笑声传遍整个灵竹林，魏明几人听到他的话连战斗的心都没了。
要杀他们的人居然是他们自己宗门的人，还是他们的亲传大师姐，这让他们怎么接受？
就在魏明等人心灰意冷之际，一道他们清淡又莫名有点熟悉的声音从后方响起。
“精彩精彩，分析的有理有据，头头是道，我看你也别来天衍宗当什么首席弟子了，有这天赋，干脆摆个摊去路边给人算命得了。”
殷裴眼一厉，“谁？”
他手腕一转，长剑在空中快速划了几下，拦在林筱面前的竹子便被砍得四分五裂，林筱的身影自也暴露在了在场所有人面前。
没有注意到魏明等人惊讶的表情，殷裴皱眉看着这个躲在竹子后偷听他们话的青衣女子，冷声问道：“你是谁？”
林筱眨眨眼，反问道：“你不知道我是谁？”
殷裴眉头皱的更紧：“我为什么要知道你是谁，快说，你什么时候来的，听到了多少，不然，休怪我剑下无情！”
林筱看向魏明，“嗯……要不你问问他们我是谁呢？”
不用殷裴询问，魏明等人就齐齐上前对着林筱弯腰行礼，“大师姐。”
殷裴一愣。
大，大师姐？
魏明等人直起身，看向殷裴的眼神变得很诡异。
殷裴刚说是他们大师姐让他来杀他们，结果他们大师姐来了，殷裴却不认识，还一再询问他们大师姐是谁，这算什么？
打脸来的不要太快。
殷裴感觉好像无形中有人在他脸上扇了一巴掌。
他脸色几番变化，实在没想到会这么巧合，自己出口陷害时，正主就在一旁听着。
深吸一口气，殷裴深深看着林筱：“你，就是天衍宗亲传大弟子？”
林筱故作疑惑：“你不认识我就说我让你去杀人，难不成天衍宗还有其他的亲传大弟子？”
殷裴铁青着脸，一句话都说不出。
有什么比说谎时被正主戳破还要更尴尬的呢。
林筱啧了一声：“让我来猜猜，你其实并不打算杀了他们，因为你知道一旦这么做了就等于破坏天衍宗和玄天剑宗的关系。”
“你只会假装无意的放走他们，然后让他们回去天衍宗说是我勾结其他宗门弟子残害自家宗门弟子，对不对？”
这些个伎俩，林筱用脚趾头都能猜到。
她也想起是在哪里听过殷裴这个名字了。
女主的备胎吗。
原剧情中洛云卿在进天衍宗之前就和这个殷裴认识，殷裴暗恋洛云卿，为了洛云卿甘愿在玄天剑宗当奸细。
是谁要陷害她，不用多说了吧。
啧，她深刻怀疑洛云卿是不是有什么受虐体质，前不久刚被她吓晕过去，这是又皮痒痒了，想被她教训了？
content_en:
Ignoring Wei Ming's slightly pale face, Yin Pei said sarcastically: "I also admire your Tianyan Sect for choosing a person with the first level of the Golden Core to be the senior sister. My Xuantian Sword Sect's chief disciple has almost reached the Nascent Soul Consummation level in cultivation."
"If your sect really doesn't have any good disciples, why not just let me be your chief disciple, hahaha."
Yin Pei's laughter spread throughout the Lingzhu Forest, and Wei Ming and others lost the intention to fight after hearing his words.
The person who wanted to kill them was actually a member of their own sect or their senior sister. How could they accept this?
Just when Wei Ming and others were feeling disheartened, a voice that was light and inexplicably familiar to them sounded from behind.
"It's wonderful, the analysis is well-founded, and it's clear and logical. I don't think you want to come to Tianyan Sect to be the chief disciple. If you have this talent, you can just set up a stall on the roadside and tell people's fortunes."
Yin Pei's eyes sharpened, "Who?"
He turned his wrist and made several quick strokes with his long sword in the air. The bamboo in front of Lin Xiao was chopped into pieces, and Lin Xiao's figure was exposed to everyone present.
Not noticing the surprised expressions of Wei Ming and others, Yin Pei frowned at the woman in green who was hiding behind the bamboo and eavesdropped on their conversation, and asked coldly: "Who are you?"
Lin Xiao blinked and asked, "You don't know who I am?"
Yin Pei's brows furrowed even more tightly: "Why do I need to know who you are? Tell me quickly, when did you come and how much did you hear? Otherwise, don't blame me for being ruthless under the sword!"
Lin Xiao looked at Wei Ming, "Well... how about you ask them who I am?"
Without Yin Pei asking, Wei Ming and others all stepped forward and bowed to Lin Xiao, "Senior Sister."
Yin Pei was stunned.
Big, senior sister?
Wei Ming and others straightened up and looked at Yin Pei with strange eyes.
Yin Pei just said that their senior sister asked him to kill them, but when their senior sister came, Yin Pei didn't recognize him and asked them repeatedly who their senior sister was. What does this mean?
Don't come too soon with the slap in the face.
Yin Pei felt as if someone had slapped him in the face.
His face changed several times. He really didn't expect such a coincidence. When he was telling the story, the real owner was listening.
Taking a deep breath, Yin Pei looked at Lin Xiao deeply: "Are you the direct disciple of Tianyan Sect?"
Lin Xiao pretended to be confused: "You don't know me and you just say that I asked you to kill people. Is it possible that there are other direct disciples of Tianyan Sect?"
Yin Pei Tie's face was livid and he couldn't say a word.
What could be more embarrassing than being exposed by the real person when you lie?
Lin Xiao clicked his tongue: "Let me guess, you don't actually intend to kill them, because you know that once you do so, it will damage the relationship between Tianyan Sect and Xuantian Sword Sect."
"You will just pretend to let them go unintentionally, and then let them go back to Tianyan Sect and say that I colluded with other sect disciples to kill my own sect disciples, right?"
Lin Xiao could guess these tricks with his toes.
She also remembered where she had heard the name Yin Pei.
The heroine’s spare tire?
In the original plot, Luo Yunqing knew Yin Pei before entering Tianyan Sect. Yin Pei had a crush on Luo Yunqing and was willing to work as a spy in Xuantian Sword Sect for Luo Yunqing.
Who wants to frame her, no need to say more.
Tsk, she had serious doubts about whether Luo Yunqing had some kind of masochistic constitution. He was scared to death by her not long ago. Was he itching again and wanted to be taught a lesson by her?
title_en: Chapter 19: You failed to save the child, go home Chapter 20: Who dares to bully my disciple of Tianyan Sect?
